_comment: District 2 (GDD §4.1: suburbs -> residential). Threat tier 2 (shadow + crawler per scripts/enemies/enemy_pool.gd): teaches courtyard stealth and vertical reading (windows, stairwells) after the suburbs tutorial. Canon anchors: blueprint_flashlight_brightness is this district's blueprint (scripts/world/district_loot.gd BLUEPRINTS), doc_old_woman = house 24 (Babka Manya), grid-crew arc continues from suburbs_note_04/07. Repair-part guarantee mirrors district_loot.gd REPAIR_PARTS (2x cable/fuse/transistor physically present per district) so FULL is always reachable. All item ids verified against data/items/*.tres (41 ids, 2026-09).

fixed_spawns.reason: Guarantee: cable for PARTIAL (cable -> PARTIAL per power_switch.gd); grid-crew cache from residential_note_07.
Guarantee: fuse for STREETS, spread into the west block so players learn stairwell stealth.
Guarantee: transistor for FULL behind the locked boiler-room door (key = residential_fix_key_01).
Boiler-room key hidden in the sandbox; playground is the safest courtyard pocket.
District blueprint (district_loot.gd BLUEPRINTS canon) with Babka Manya; gated behind first partial power.
The old woman shares supplies; safe-ish heal cache after the crawler-heavy courtyards.
Defense cache before the east exit to park; STREETS stage only.
Battery cache at the district gate — top-up pushed forward from suburbs exit cache.

rules: R1: In DARK, fixed_spawns alone must cover the repair chain (>=2 cable, >=2 fuse, >=2 transistor reachable; transistor door key obtainable without lockpick).
R2: Rolled loot never includes stage-gated items early: table lookup uses the CURRENT DistrictData.Stage only.
R3: Fixed spawns are one-time per save; rolls are per-container with container_modifiers on qty.
R4: No firearms in residential (tier 2 stealth district; molotov/firework/noise_bomb remain the ceiling). Serum first appears in STREETS rolls.
R5: Courtyard containers (trash_bin, laundry_basket, mail_box) carry the rolled loot; apartment interiors carry the fixed story caches — stealth risk maps to reward.
R6: house 24 caches (blueprint, medkits) must not roll empty: Babka Manya's door is a scripted kindness, not RNG.
